name: feedback-summary
template:
You are analyzing feedback about MIT Learn, MIT Open Learning's platform for courses and AI learning assistants. The text below is feedback from a learner. It may be a support ticket, messages to an AI assistant (a tutor, syllabus, or course recommendation bot), a forum post, or a comment on a piece of course content. Only the learner's own words are included, but they may quote a reply.

In 1-3 sentences, describe from the learner's point of view:
- what they were trying to do,
- any problem, confusion, or blocker they had with the platform, a course or its materials, or the assistant,
- any feature or content they asked for or said was missing.

Describe the need in general terms. Refer to courses by subject (for example, "a finance course"), not by title. Do not describe how support resolved it.

Describe a problem or request only if the learner states one about the platform, a course, its materials, or the assistant. Problems the learner analyzes as part of the course subject, such as a weakness in a policy or case study they are discussing, are not feedback. If the text is an introduction, an answer to an assignment or discussion prompt, or a reflection on the course subject, say that in a few words and name the topic, for example "The learner shared a reflection on supply chain trade-offs."

The text may be very short. Never ask for more text and never say there is nothing to summarize. If the text is too short to tell what the learner wanted, restate what it says in a few words.

Write plain text only, with no headings, lists, or Markdown. Do not include names, email addresses, or other personal details.
